core: Hormonal control of insulin and glucagon secretion
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are receptor-driven (free fatty acid, GLP-1, acetylcholine, adrenergic, HCA receptors) and cAMP/PKA/PDE3B/AMPK regulators of islet insulin and glucagon secretion, unlike confusables centred on insulin action, KATP channels, lipid gene regulation or glycogen metabolism.

name: Major spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition
rationale: All members cover U2-type spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and catalytic activation, whereas confusables concern snRNA transcription, snRNP biogenesis and splicing regulation.

qualifier: NK cell and CD8 T cell
name: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation and tolerance
rationale: Members span NK cell signatures and cytotoxicity, CD8 T cell proliferation, MHC class I/Ib presentation, costimulation and peripheral tolerance, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on Treg and T helper suppression.

name: Direct reversal of DNA alkylation and active DNA demethylation
rationale: All members remove methyl or alkyl groups from DNA bases (ALKBH2/3, MGMT, TET/TDG demethylation), unlike confusables covering base excision repair, cytosine deamination or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: restraint of myeloid and B lineage differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and restraint of lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division plus negative regulation of B, monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation (including VENTX), while confusables cover RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte maturation or bone marrow development.

name: T cell activation, signalling and thymic differentiation
rationale: Members are mainly T cell activation/signalling modules, TCR-IL2-IL7 networks and thymocyte, CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation, whereas the confusables are dominated by B cell development and BCR signalling.

core: Atrial and AV node action potential
name: Atrial myocyte repolarization and AV node depolarization
rationale: All three members concern action potential phases in atrial and atrioventricular node cells, and atrial repolarization separates the theme from confusables about ventricular and conduction-system depolarization or generic cardiac phases.

qualifier: presynaptic glutamate and calcium channel signalling
name: Neuronal excitability, presynaptic signalling and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members mix neuronal action potential and calcium channel control, presynaptic active zone and mGluR signalling with touch, vision, prepulse inhibition and movement behaviours; the presynaptic and channel members distinguish it from behaviour-only or glycinergic confusables.

name: NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan sensing and antibacterial signalling
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2 responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, NLR/inflammasome signalling and K63 ubiquitination, unlike confusables centred on TLR-TAK1-IKK cascades or bacterial detection generally.

name: FcεRI-mediated mast cell activation and degranulation
rationale: All members concern mast cell differentiation, FcεRI signalling (Ca2+, MAPK, NF-kB, LAT2), degranulation, histamine release and type I hypersensitivity, while confusables centre on Th2 cytokines and eosinophils.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolytic and lactate flux
rationale: Members regulate glycolysis via fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, pentose-phosphate branching and lactate fermentation, distinguishing them from confusables on core glucose catabolism or p53/mTORC1 metabolic genes.

name: PTK6 (BRK) tyrosine kinase signalling and regulation
rationale: Every member describes PTK6 activation, effectors (STAT3, RTKs, RHO/RAS, RNA processing) or down-regulation, whereas confusables are broad RTK, FGFR, ERBB and RAS-MAPK signalling.

name: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 type 2 responses
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13 production, IL-4/IL-13 and IL-33 signalling, IgE switching and anti-nematode immunity, distinguishing it from confusables focused on FcεRI mast cell signalling or eosinophils.

name: Xenobiotic and natural-product toxin detoxification with sulfonation
rationale: Members span xenobiotic, steroid, flavone, polyketide and mycotoxin metabolism with cytosolic sulfonation and PAP metabolism, separating it from confusables on drug ADME transport, CYP/FMO oxidation of amines and alcohols.

name: Arp2/3-WAVE-driven lamellipodium and ruffle protrusion
rationale: Members regulate Arp2/3 nucleation, WASP/WAVE activation and lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, whereas confusables cover actin severing, bundling, capping and Rho GTPase cycles.

name: SLC39 zinc/manganese influx and ferroportin iron-export disorders
rationale: Members cover SLC39-mediated zinc, manganese and cadmium uptake and homeostasis plus ferroportin and ceruloplasmin defects, distinguishing it from confusables on copper, metallothioneins and iron uptake.

name: Heparan sulfate degradation and Sanfilippo syndromes (MPS III)
rationale: Members are glycosaminoglycan (mainly heparan sulfate) degradation and the four MPS III subtypes, separating the theme from confusables covering other MPS types and chondroitin or keratan sulfate.

name: Fibroblast migration, survival and myofibroblast differentiation control
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast apoptosis, migration and (myo)fibroblast differentiation in connective tissue replacement, whereas confusables concern ECM assembly, collagen and TGF-beta production.

qualifier: sensing, ATM signalling and classical NHEJ
name: Double-strand break sensing, signalling and classical NHEJ
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM-mediated recruitment, chromatin remodeling, PARylation regulation and classical NHEJ, distinguishing it from confusables on alternative NHEJ, BRCA1/2 defects and HR strand invasion.

core: Ceramide signalling and growth factor response
name: Sphingomyelin-ceramide signalling and insulin-like growth factor response
rationale: Members split between sphingomyelin catabolism to ceramide (TNFR1, sphingolipid synthesis) and IGF/peptide hormone responses including hormone-induced apoptosis; the ceramide arm separates it from FOXO and bone confusables.

name: Regulation of osteoblast differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, bone mineralization during maturation and chondrocyte development, while confusables concern Wnt and mesenchymal stem cell, trabecula and tendon formation.

name: Amino acid and energy sensing control of mTORC1
rationale: All members regulate TORC1 via leucine, methionine, glucose/energy (LKB1-AMPK) and AKT-TSC inputs, unlike confusables on mTORC1/p53 metabolic gene programmes, FOXO or protein methylation.

qualifier: Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor maturation
name: TCA cycle with Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates, OGDH and succinate dehydrogenase steps plus the Fe-S cluster assembly and protein lipoylation that mature TCA enzymes, distinguishing it from PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and other DLD-complex confusables.

name: Inhibition of VEGF signalling and sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members negatively regulate VEGF receptor signalling or endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis and migration in sprouting, while confusables include pro-angiogenic and cell-adhesion regulation.

name: L1-CAM/ankyrin nodal assembly and connexin gap junction formation
rationale: Members combine L1-family CAM (neurofascin, NrCAM, CHL1)-ankyrin sodium channel clustering and paranodal assembly with connexin trafficking and gap junction formation, the latter absent from L1, adhesion and myelination confusables.
